regions.description: North edge deep green woodland curtain. Irregular lower border descending into northwest corner; west edge crowns overlap an existing forest. Trunks visible at the south fringe.
North-eastern deep woods continuous canopy, dense varied leaf clusters, subtle old conifers among oaks, irregular south fringe.
Tall vertical eastern woodland; foliage continues off right edge; ragged WEST margin showing many distinct crowns and trunks near clearing, irregular bottom.
Deep southwest forest and lower map edge, abundant layered crowns of oak and narrow conifer, ragged northeast edge, roots near the border.
Dense deep southern woods spanning bottom edge, irregular upper border opening to village clearing. Rich natural overlapping 3/4 tree crowns, trunks toward clearings.
Dense south east forest and bottom-right edge, contiguous mature trees with tall conifers and hardwoods, staggered upper border, sunlit leafy fringes.

rule: one provider-source independent RGBA per region; road and house cutouts; never conflate art and engine QA
